svg.title: LIDAR point clouds of the same cliff in 2008 and 2023, with a section through both
svg.desc: Oblique views of the raw Environment Agency LIDAR points for a 220 by 120 metre block of cliff at Aldbrough in 2008 and 2023, and a cross-section through both showing the cliff face 38 metres further inland in 2023.
svg.text: The same cliff as two point clouds: 2008 and 2023
Land on the left, sea on the right. Heights tripled.
Section A to B: every LIDAR point within 1.5 m of the line (m, Ordnance Datum)
Distance along the section (m). Vertical scale exaggerated 2.2 times.
All returns are shown, including vegetation and buildings, as surveyed. Flown 15 September 2008 and 20 April 2023.
Drawn by Beck & Call Digital from Environment Agency LIDAR point cloud tiles (LAZ).
